'''Lamine Yamal Nasraoui Ebana'''{{efn-ua|{{IPA|es|laˈmiɲ‿ɟʝaˈmal nasˈraɣwj‿eˈβana|small=no}}; {{IPA|ca|ləˈmin jəˈmal nəzˈrawi əˈβanə|small=no}}}} (born 13 July 2007), commonly known as '''Lamine Yamal''', is a Spanish professional [[footballer]] who plays as a [[Winger (association football)|right winger]] for the {{Spanish football updater|Barcelona}} club [[FC  Barcelona|Barcelona]] and the [[Spain national football team|Spain national team]]. He is widely regarded as one of the best players in the world.{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 May 2026 |title=Barcelona coach Flick: Waving Palestine flag Yamal's call |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48751781/barcelona-flick-palestine-flag-yamal |access-date=2026-08-09 |website=ESPN |quote='''The 18-year-old winger, who is already widely regarded as one of the best soccer players in the world...'''}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/13530552/lamine-yamal-is-already-the-world-s-best-player-at-18-but-can-he-inspire-barcelona-to-a-champions-league-remontada |title=Lamine Yamal is already the world's best player at 18 but can he inspire Barcelona to a Champions League remontada? |publisher=Sky Sports |date=14 April 2026 |access-date=10 August 2026}}</ref><ref name=":2" />}}

Yamal{{efn-ua|Publications such as ''[[The New York Times]]'', ''[[Chicago Tribune]]'', and ''[[Al Jazeera]]'' refer to him simply as "Yamal". Kyle Bonn of ''[[The Sporting News]]'' has written that it is improper to call him "Yamal", as it is not his surname.<ref>{{cite web |last=Pathak |first=Manasi |title=Beauty and grace: Spain prodigy Lamine Yamal’s game lives up to his name |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/15/lamine-yamal-name-history-barcelona-spain-fifa-world-cup-final-2026-what-to-know |date=15 July 2026 |access-date=17 July 2026 |website=Al Jazeera |archive-date=17 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260717041744/https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/15/lamine-yamal-name-history-barcelona-spain-fifa-world-cup-final-2026-what-to-know |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Joseph |date=2026-07-18 |title=Lionel Messi once held baby Lamine Yamal in his arms. Now they will battle for the World Cup title. |url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/07/18/world-cup-lionel-messi-lamine-yamal/ |access-date=2026-07-20 |website=Chicago Tribune |language=en-US |archive-date=20 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260720024731/https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/07/18/world-cup-lionel-messi-lamine-yamal/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Corrigan |first=Dermot |date=14 July 2026 |title=The story behind Lamine Yamal’s full name – and who he is named after |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7442585/2026/07/14/lamine-yamal-spain-world-cup-name-france/ |access-date=17 July 2026 |work=The New York Times |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Bonn |first=Kyle |date=16 June 2026 |title=Why does Lamine Yamal have full name on jersey during World Cup games? |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/soccer/news/why-lamine-yamal-full-name-jersey-world-cup-spain/292061e266f2407fe840360d |access-date=17 July 2026 |website=The Sporting News |archive-date=17 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260717082428/https://www.sportingnews.com/us/soccer/news/why-lamine-yamal-full-name-jersey-world-cup-spain/292061e266f2407fe840360d |url-status=live }}</ref>}} was a member of Barcelona's youth academy, [[La Masia]], before joining the first team in the [[2023–24 FC Barcelona season|2023–24 season]]. At age 17, he became the youngest player to be nominated for the [[Ballon d'Or]], and in 2024 and 2025 he won the [[Kopa Trophy]], awarded to the best young player in the world. Under manager [[Hansi Flick]], Yamal emerged as a key player for Barcelona, helping the club win a [[domestic treble]] in the [[2024–25 FC Barcelona season|2024–25]] season: La Liga, the [[Copa del Rey]] and the [[Supercopa de España]]. Barcelona retained the La Liga title in the [[2025–26 La Liga|2025–26]] season, with Yamal being named [[La Liga Awards#Player of the season|La Liga Player of the Season]]. At 18 years old, he was rated as the best player in Europe according to performance tracking data,{{Efn|According to ''WhoScored.com'', Yamal was the "European Player of the Season" across the top leagues, with a rating of 8.01.

''WhoScored.com'' is described by ''[[The Guardian]]'' as "the largest detailed football statistics website".<ref>
*{{cite news |title=WhoScored? |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/who-scored-blog |access-date=5 August 2026 |work=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref>

Yamal ranked first for assists (13), first for dribbles (161), first for possession won in the attacking third (35), and first for big chances created (28).}} and finished as runner-up for the [[2025 Ballon d'Or]].

Yamal has represented Spain internationally at various [[Spain national youth football team|youth levels]] and made his debut for the senior team in 2023, becoming the youngest player to represent the country at age 16. In 2024, he became the youngest player to score in the [[UEFA European Championship]], earning the [[UEFA European Championship awards#Young Player of the Tournament|Young Player Award]] as Spain achieved their [[UEFA Euro 2024|fourth title]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Batlle |first=Nick |date=19 April 2026 |title=Barcelona must do more to maximize the potential of Lamine Yamal |url=https://www.barcablaugranes.com/cant-del-blog-barcelona-opinion/118031/barcelona-must-do-more-to-maximize-the-potential-of-lamine-yamal |access-date=19 April 2026 |website=Barca Blaugranes |archive-date=20 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260420030846/https://www.barcablaugranes.com/cant-del-blog-barcelona-opinion/118031/barcelona-must-do-more-to-maximize-the-potential-of-lamine-yamal |url-status=live }}</ref> At Yamal's [[FIFA World Cup]] debut in [[2026 FIFA World Cup|2026]], he won his first World Cup title.

==Early life==
Lamine Yamal Nasraoui Ebana was born on 13 July 2007, in [[Esplugues de Llobregat]] in the [[Barcelona metropolitan area]] in [[Catalonia]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Who is Lamine Yamal? Barcelona wonderkid making history in La Liga and for Spain |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/soccer/news/lamine-yamal-barcelona-la-liga-spain-records-playing-style/723f032776a836c20966f8ac |website=Sporting News |date=9 July 2024 |access-date=26 July 2024 |archive-date=27 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240727031941/https://www.sportingnews.com/us/soccer/news/lamine-yamal-barcelona-la-liga-spain-records-playing-style/723f032776a836c20966f8ac |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=Corbella>{{Cite web |last=Corbella |first=Enrique|title=Lamine Yamal, el niño de 15 años que ya entrena con el Barcelona: descubre al "mini Messi" de La Masía |url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/barcelona/2022/09/05/6315a6aa268e3ead0d8b4588.html|date=5 September 2022|access-date=6 September 2022|website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |language=es |archive-date=6 September 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220906214946/https://www.marca.com/futbol/barcelona/2022/09/05/6315a6aa268e3ead0d8b4588.html }}</ref> Yamal's father, Mounir Nasraoui, is from a village between [[Larache]] and [[Ksar el-Kebir]] in Morocco.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Allam |first=Abd al-Rahim |date=2026-07-16 |title=لامين يامال: ملهم "روكافوندا" الذي طوّع كرة القدم بين الشارع والأكاديمية |url=https://thevoice.ma/%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%88%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D9%8A-%D8%B7%D9%88%D9%91%D8%B9/ |access-date=2026-07-18 |website=Sawt al-Maghrib |language=ar}}</ref> His mother, Sheila Ebana, is from [[Bata, Equatorial Guinea|Bata]], Equatorial Guinea.{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref>{{Cite news |last=Roy |first=Prantik Prabal |date=2026-07-10 |title=Who are Lamine Yamal's parents? Meet Mounir Nasraoui and Sheila Ebana, their ethnicity and more |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/international-sports/who-are-lamine-yamals-parents-meet-mounir-nasraoui-and-sheila-ebana-their-ethnicity-and-more/articleshow/132312230.cms |access-date=2026-07-18 |work=[[The Times of India]] |issn=0971-8257 |archive-date=18 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260718172305/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/international-sports/who-are-lamine-yamals-parents-meet-mounir-nasraoui-and-sheila-ebana-their-ethnicity-and-more/articleshow/132312230.cms |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="espn">{{cite web |last1=Marsden |first1=Sam |last2=Llorens |first2=Moises |title=The story of 16-year-old Lamine Yamal, destined to be Barcelona's next superstar |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/38354902/the-story-16-year-old-lamine-yamal-barca-next-superstar |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=10 July 2024 |date=10 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240615143216/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/38354902/the-story-16-year-old-lamine-yamal-barca-next-superstar |archive-date=15 June 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Billebault |first1=Alexis |title=Lamine Yamal, le surdoué du foot que tout le Maroc attend - Jeune Afrique.com |url=https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1555586/societe/lamine-yamal-le-surdoue-du-foot-que-tout-le-maroc-attend/ |website=[[Jeune Afrique]]|access-date=10 July 2024 |language=fr|date=10 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604110717/https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1555586/societe/lamine-yamal-le-surdoue-du-foot-que-tout-le-maroc-attend/ |archive-date=4 June 2024}}</ref>}} Yamal has a younger half-brother and a younger half-sister.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Abhishek |date=2024-07-14 |title=Who Is Lamine Yamal's Mother? Meet Sheila Ebana, the Woman Behind the Spain Star's Viral Pic With Lionel Messi |url=https://www.essentiallysports.com/soccer-football-news-who-is-lamine-yamal-mother-meet-sheila-ebana-the-woman-behind-the-spain-star-viral-pic-with-lionel-messi/ |access-date=2025-05-06 |website=EssentiallySports |language=en |archive-date=14 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250614171414/https://www.essentiallysports.com/soccer-football-news-who-is-lamine-yamal-mother-meet-sheila-ebana-the-woman-behind-the-spain-star-viral-pic-with-lionel-messi/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Shigjeqi |first=Egzona |date=2024-10-29 |title=Lamine Yamal's younger brother stole all the attention at the Ballon d'Or ceremony - Telegraph |url=https://telegrafi.com/en/Lamine-Yamal%27s-younger-brother-stole-all-the-attention-at-the-Ballon-d%27Or-ceremony/ |access-date=2025-05-06 |language=en |archive-date=12 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250512010831/https://telegrafi.com/en/Lamine-Yamal%27s-younger-brother-stole-all-the-attention-at-the-Ballon-d%27Or-ceremony/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He has a [[compound given name]] to honour two family friends, Lamine and Yamal, who helped his parents financially shortly before Yamal was born.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mumford |first=Robin |date=2024-09-23 |title=The reason why Lamine Yamal wears both names on back of his shirt |url=https://www.givemesport.com/why-lamine-yamal-wears-both-names-on-back-of-his-shirt/ |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=GiveMeSport |language=en |archive-date=14 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250614171414/https://www.givemesport.com/why-lamine-yamal-wears-both-names-on-back-of-his-shirt/ |url-status=live }}</ref> As a baby he was featured in a [[2007 Messi–Yamal photo shoot|2007 UNICEF charity photo shoot]] with his future club [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], during which he was bathed by a 20-year-old [[Lionel Messi]]. The photos [[Viral phenomenon|went viral]] online in 2024 after Yamal's father posted one of them online. Two years later, the photos received additional attention in the media as Yamal and Messi prepared to face each other in the [[2026 FIFA World Cup final]].{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-07-11 |title=Lionel Messi Once Bathed Baby Lamine Yamal. Now, They Could Face Off In the World Cup |url=https://www.today.com/popculture/news/lionel-messi-lamine-yamal-baby-bathed-throwback-rcna353523 |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=TODAY.com |language=en |archive-date=15 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260715070710/https://www.today.com/popculture/news/lionel-messi-lamine-yamal-baby-bathed-throwback-rcna353523 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-10 |title=Lamine Yamal: Photos of Lionel Messi bathing Spain wonderkid as a baby resurface |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c7206gj5w28o |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=www.bbc.com |language=en-GB |archive-date=3 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251003152507/https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c7206gj5w28o |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=17 July 2026|title=God’s will? Destiny? Lionel Messi, Lamine Yamal, that photo and the World Cup final|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jul/17/gods-will-destiny-lionel-messi-lamine-yamal-that-photo-and-the-world-cup-final |access-date=19 July 2026|website=The Guardian |language=en-GB|last=Lowe|first=Sid}}</ref>}}

An important figure in Yamal's upbringing was his paternal grandmother, Fatima, who migrated from [[Tangier]], Morocco, to Spain in 1990.<ref name="OkDiarioFatima">{{cite news |title=Fátima, la desconocida mujer que ha marcado la vida personal del futbolista Lamine Yamal |url=https://okdiario.com/cool/actualidad/fatima-desconocida-mujer-que-marcado-vida-personal-del-futbolista-lamine-yamal-16922886 |work=[[OKDiario]] |access-date=16 July 2026 |language=es |archive-date=16 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260716143940/https://okdiario.com/cool/actualidad/fatima-desconocida-mujer-que-marcado-vida-personal-del-futbolista-lamine-yamal-16922886 |url-status=live }}</ref> Facing financial hardship, she worked to anchor the family in [[Rocafonda]], a neighbourhood in the city of [[Mataró]] in [[Catalonia]]. When Yamal's parents separated during his early childhood, Fatima took on a vital role in raising him, managing his daily routine and ensuring he could attend training sessions.<ref name="ElPaisRocafonda">{{cite news |last=Guevara |first=Irene |title=Rocafonda, the neighborhood that regained its pride thanks to soccer sensation Lamine Yamal |url=https://english.elpais.com/ |work=[[El País]] |date=11 July 2024 |access-date=13 July 2024 |archive-date=13 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240713032414/https://english.elpais.com/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Yamal started playing football at the age of four at local club La Torreta in [[Granollers]], where his mother was living.<ref name="Herrero">{{cite news |last1=Herrero |first1=Laia Cervelló |title=Lamine Yamal: Barcelona's young prodigy and the proud neighbourhood that shaped him |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4997511/2023/10/26/barcelona-lamine-yamal-rocafonda-el-clasico/ |website=The New York Times |access-date=10 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251103002834/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4997511/2023/10/26/barcelona-lamine-yamal-rocafonda-el-clasico/ |archive-date= 2025-11-03|date=26 October 2023|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="thetimes">{{cite news |last1=Hawkey |first1=Ian |title=Super-prodigy with 'flashes of Messi': the rise of Spain's Lamine Yamal |url=https://www.thetimes.com/sport/football/article/super-prodigy-with-flashes-of-messi-rise-of-spains-lamine-yamal-rprp5fkfj |website=[[The Times]] |access-date=10 July 2024 |archive-date=25 He alternated between Mataró and Granollers to spend time with both his parents.<ref name="ausarticle">{{cite web |last1=Ducker |first1=James |title=Meeting Messi as a baby, stunners for his country Following his success, his popularisation of the number has been credited with bringing pride and recognition to the working class community of Rocafonda.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Guevara |first1=Irene |title=Rocafonda, the neighborhood that regained its pride thanks to soccer sensation Lamine Yamal |url=https://english.elpais.com/sports/2024-07-11/rocafonda-the-neighborhood-that-regained-its-pride-thanks-to-soccer-sensation-lamine-yamal.html |access-date=13 July 2024 |work=El País |date=11 July 2024 |archive-date=17 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240717135436/https://english.elpais.com/sports/2024-07-11/rocafonda-the-neighborhood-that-regained-its-pride-thanks-to-soccer-sensation-lamine-yamal.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lamine Yamal: Barcelona football star inspires youth in hometown Rocafonda |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2025/5/25/lamine-yamal-barcelona-football-star-inspires-youth-in-hometown-rocafonda |date=25 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260210101002/https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2025/5/25/lamine-yamal-barcelona-football-star-inspires-youth-in-hometown-rocafonda |archive-date= 2026-02-10|work=Al Jazeera |last=Keeley |first=Graham }}</ref>

At six years old, Yamal was scouted by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] and was invited to training sessions at [[La Masia]]. He signed for the club in 2014 and moved to Barcelona to live and train at the academy.<ref name="espn" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last1=Picó|first1=Diego|last2=Gillingham|first2=Geoff|title=Lamine Yamal shows shades of Messi|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/barcelona/2019/12/28/5e072c5722601dbe358b45a6.html |url-status=live|date=28 December 2019|access-date=6 September 2022|website=Marca|archive-date=9 September 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220909141431/https://www.marca.com/en/football/barcelona/2019/12/28/5e072c5722601dbe358b45a6.html }}</ref> Growing up, Yamal's footballing idols were [[Ronaldinho]], Messi and [[Neymar]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.90min.com/lamine-yamal-names-three-barcelona-legends-footballing-idols | title=Lamine Yamal names three Barcelona legends as his footballing idols | date=17 December 2024 | access-date=4 May 2025 | archive-date=17 December 2024 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241217175302/https://www.90min.com/lamine-yamal-names-three-barcelona-legends-footballing-idols | url-status=live }}</ref>

== Club career ==

=== Youth career ===
As Yamal progressed through the ranks of Barcelona's [[La Masia]] youth academy, he was soon considered one of its best prospects.<ref name=":1" /> Initially added to the [[FC Barcelona (youth)|Juvenil A]] team – already above his age grade – for the [[2022–23 FC Barcelona season|2022–23 season]],<ref>{{Cite web|first=Ferran|last=Martínez|title=Julián Araujo, un 'tapado' para el lateral derecho |url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/fc-barcelona/20220831/1001859973/julian-araujo-tapado-lateral-derecho.html|date=31 August 2022|access-date=6 September 2022|website=[[Mundo Deportivo]]|language=es |archive-date=9 September 2022 === 2023–24: First team breakthrough ===
Although Yamal remained on Barcelona's [[FC Barcelona Atlètic|reserve team]] throughout the [[2023–24 La Liga|2023–24 season]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-02-25 |title=Barça Atlètic Squad - FC Barcelona Official Channel |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/barca-b/players |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240225194746/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/barca-b/players |url-status=dead |archive-date=2024-02-25 |access-date=2024-07-15 }}</ref> he earned his first start for the club on 20 August 2023 during a 2–0 victory over [[Cádiz CF|Cádiz]] at the [[Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys]].<ref name="youngstart">{{Cite web|title=Lamine Yamal, youngest FC Barcelona starter ever|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3644506/lamine-yamal-youngest-fc-barcelona-starter-ever|website=[[FC Barcelona]]|date=21 August 2023 |access-date=22 August 2023 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Thomas|last=Schlachter|title=Lamine Yamal becomes youngest La Liga starter in 21st century in Barcelona's 2-0 win against Cádiz|url=https://edition.cnn.com/2023/08/21/sport/lamine-yamal-youngest-starter-barcelona-spt-intl/index.html|website=[[CNN]]|date=21 August 2023|access-date=22 August 2023|archive-date=10 October youngest Barcelona starter in history,<ref name="youngstart" /> and was met with a standing ovation.<ref>{{cite web|first=Pol|last=Ballús|title=Yamal shines again for Barcelona as Xavi turns to 'fearless' 16-year-old in attack |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4792442/2023/08/21/barcelona-lamine-yamal-ansu-fati-xavi-cadiz/|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=22 August 2024}}</ref> In his next starting appearance, he was named [[Player of the match|Man of the Match]] after providing two assists during a 4–3 victory over [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] on 28 August.<ref>{{cite web|title=Villarreal 3–4 FC Barcelona: Rollercoaster ride to victory |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3655925/villarreal-3-4-fc-barcelona-rollercoaster-ride-to-victory |website=FC Barcelona|date=28 August 2023 |access-date=27 August 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Watch: 16-year-old Lamine Yamal's highlights after incredible Barcelona performance the second-youngest player in history to play in the tournament.<ref name="youngcl">{{cite web |date=19 September 2023 |title=Youngest Champions League players: Moukoko, Yamal, Babayaro, Cherki, On 11 January 2024, Yamal scored in a 2–0 win over [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] in the [[2024 Supercopa de España|semi-final]] of the [[Supercopa de España]], becoming the youngest player to score in the Supercopa, at 16 years and 182 days old.<ref name="goalsensation">{{Cite web |date=11 January 2024 |title=Watch: Lamine Yamal making more history! 16-year-old Barcelona sensation breaks Supercopa goalscoring record after late strike against Osasuna |url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/watch-lamine-yamal-history-16-year-old-barcelona-sensation-supercopa-goalscoring-record-osasuna/bltd41eed3f97af8ab6 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240111223729/https://www.goal.com/en/lists/watch-lamine-yamal-history-16-year-old-barcelona-sensation-supercopa-goalscoring-record-osasuna/bltd41eed3f97af8ab6 |archive-date=11 January 2024 |access-date=10 February 2024 |website=[[Goal (website)|Goal]]}}</ref> Two weeks later, he scored in the [[Copa del Rey]] quarter-final against [[Athletic Bilbao]] in an |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240125120608/https://www.barcablaugranes.com/2024/1/25/24050130/lamine-yamal-apologises-to-barcelona-fans-after-copa-del-rey-defeat-to-athletic |archive-date=25 January 2024 |access-date=10 February 2024 |website=Barca Blaugranes}}</ref> On 11 February, Yamal scored his first [[Hat-trick#Football codes|brace]] in a 3–3 draw against [[Granada CF|Granada]], and was named Man of the Match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 February 2024 |title=FC Barcelona 3-3 Granada: Held at home in six-goal thriller |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3892232/fc-barcelona-3-3-granada-held-at-home-in-six-goal-thriller |url-status=live February 2024 |access-date=12 February 2024 |website=FC Barcelona}}</ref> At the conclusion of the [[2023–24 FC Barcelona season|2023–24 season]], Barcelona finished second in La Liga and were eliminated from Champions League contention in the quarter-finals by [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]] (PSG). Yamal served an assist against PSG in the second leg, which Barcelona lost 4–1.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sevilla 1-2 FC Barcelona: Winning end to the season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/4028501/sevilla-1-2-fc-barcelona-winning-end-to-the-season |publisher=FC Barcelona |access-date=10 July 2024 |date=27 May 2024 |archive-date=29 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251229134431/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/4028501/sevilla-1-2-fc-barcelona-winning-end-to-the-season |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Barcelona 1-4 Paris St-Germain (Agg: 4-6): Kylian Mbappe scores twice as PSG reach last four |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/68819301 |website=BBC Sport |access-date=10 July 2024 |date=15 April 2024 |archive-date=1 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240601224314/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/68819301 |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== 2024–25: 100th appearance for Barcelona and second Kopa Trophy ===
In the first match of the [[2024–25 La Liga|2024–25 La Liga season]] on 18 August, Yamal served an assist to help Barcelona defeat [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] 2–1.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Valencia vs Barcelona |url=https://www.sofascore.com/football/match/valencia-barcelona/rgbsDgb |access-date=September 17, 2024 |website=[[Sofascore]] |archive-date=17 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917183032/https://www.sofascore.com/football/match/valencia-barcelona/rgbsDgb |url-status=live }}</ref> In the following match against [[Athletic Bilbao]] on 24 August, he scored his first goal of the season in another 2–1 victory.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Barcelona vs Athletic Club |url=https://www.sofascore.com/football/match/athletic-club-barcelona/rgbsAgb#id:12437652 |access-date=September 17, 2024 |website=[[Sofascore]] |archive-date=17 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917183032/https://www.sofascore.com/football/match/athletic-club-barcelona/rgbsAgb#id:12437652 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 19 September, he scored his first Champions League goal during a 2–1 loss to [[AS Monaco|Monaco]] in the [[2024–25 UEFA Champions League league phase|Champions League league phase]], becoming the second-youngest scorer in Champions League history.<ref>{{cite web |date=19 September 2024 |title=Lamine Yamal makes history again |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4122787/lamine-yamal-makes-history-again |access-date=27 September 2024 |website=[[FC Barcelona]] |language=en |archive-date=21 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240921025836/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4122787/lamine-yamal-makes-history-again |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c04ppddv50et |title=Monaco 2-1 Barcelona: George Ilenikhena scores as 10-man Barca beaten in Champions League |publisher=[[BBC Sport]] |date=19 September 2024 |access-date=20 September 2024 |first=Marissa |last=Thomas |archive-date=20 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240920004524/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c04ppddv50et |url-status=live }}</ref> On 26 October, he became the youngest goalscorer in [[El Clásico]] history when he scored once in a 4-0 victory over [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] at the [[Santiago Bernabeu Stadium|Santiago Bernabeu]] in Madrid. During the match, Yamal and his teammates Fati and [[Raphinha]] were targeted with racial abuse by a group of Real Madrid supporters.<ref>{{cite web|date=26 October 2024|title=Lamine Yamal youngest Clásico goalscorer|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/4156854/lamine-yamal-youngest-clasico-goalscorer|access-date=28 October 2024|website=[[FC Barcelona]]|language=en|archive-date=7 December 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241207183022/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/4156854/lamine-yamal-youngest-clasico-goalscorer|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=26 October 2024|title='No place for these criminals in our society!' - Vinicius Junior sends support to Lamine Yamal, Raphinha & Ansu Fati after seeing Barcelona trio targeted with racist insults in El Clasico win at Real Madrid|url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/no-place-criminals-society-vinicius-junior-sends-support-lamine-yamal-raphinha-ansu-fati-barcelona-trio-targeted-racist-insults-el-clasico-real-madrid/blt051e17049c4c2523#cs5523e9e83afd302b|access-date=28 October 2024|website=[[goal.com]]|language=en|archive-date=3 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241103203326/https://www.goal.com/en/lists/no-place-criminals-society-vinicius-junior-sends-support-lamine-yamal-raphinha-ansu-fati-barcelona-trio-targeted-racist-insults-el-clasico-real-madrid/blt051e17049c4c2523#cs5523e9e83afd302b|url-status=live}}</ref>

After scoring in a 5–0 win over Valencia in the [[2024–25 Copa del Rey#Quarter-finals|Copa del Rey quarter-finals]] on 6 February 2025, Yamal failed to score for over a month.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lamine Yamal Silences Critics with Stunning Goal After Month-Long Drought |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/uefa-champions-league/articles-video/lamine-yamal-silences-critics-with-stunning-goal-after-month-long-drought-2025-03-12 |access-date=2026-03-08 |website=BeIn Sports |archive-date=21 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260421112528/https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/uefa-champions-league/articles-video/lamine-yamal-silences-critics-with-stunning-goal-after-month-long-drought-2025-03-12 |url-status=live }}</ref> His goalscoring drought in La Liga ran from 26 October 2024 to 18 March 2025,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lamine Yamal sends message to critics after ending La Liga Goal Drought|url=https://www.thesportsfire.com/lamine-yamal-sends-message-to-critics-after-ending-la-liga-goal-drought/|access-date=2026-03-08 |website=The Sports Fire}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title='He still scores few goals' - Barcelona wonderkid Lamine Yamal accused of 'dropping a bit' after goal drought as Italy legend Francesco Totti has his say on teenager's big problem|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/barcelona-wonderkid-lamine-yamal-accused-la-liga-francesco-totti-teenager-form/blt6b745bc78ac6d499|access-date=2026-03-08|website=Goal|archive-date=20 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260720100432/https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/barcelona-wonderkid-lamine-yamal-accused-la-liga-francesco-totti-teenager-form/blt6b745bc78ac6d499|url-status=live}}</ref> prompting former player [[Francesco Totti]] to label him a player who scores "few goals".<ref>{{Cite web|title='He still scores few goals' - Barcelona wonderkid Lamine Yamal accused of 'dropping a bit' after goal drought as Italy legend Francesco Totti has his say on teenager's big problem|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/barcelona-wonderkid-lamine-yamal-accused-la-liga-francesco-totti-teenager-form/blt6b745bc78ac6d499|access-date=2026-03-08|website=Goal|archive-date=20 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260720100432/https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/barcelona-wonderkid-lamine-yamal-accused-la-liga-francesco-totti-teenager-form/blt6b745bc78ac6d499|url-status=live}}</ref> During this period, manager [[Hansi Flick]] defended Yamal, stating: "Everyone wants to score, but he creates a lot of chances. The important thing is that the team scores, not who scores."<ref>{{Cite web|title=Why Lamine Yamal’s La Liga goal drought does not concern Barcelona – with teenage wonderkid still contributing significantly to bids for three more trophies|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/lamine-yamal-la-liga-goal-drought-concern-barcelona-teenage-wonderkid-bids-three-trophies/blt5f60b5ea7c64f9ac|access-date=2026-03-08|website=Goal|archive-date=20 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260720101536/https://www.goal.com/en-gb/lists/lamine-yamal-la-liga-goal-drought-concern-barcelona-teenage-wonderkid-bids-three-trophies/blt5f60b5ea7c64f9ac|url-status=live}}</ref> On 30 April, Yamal made his 100th appearance for Barcelona in the Champions League [[2024–25 UEFA Champions League#Semi-finals|semi-finals]] against [[Inter Milan]], scoring a goal in a 3–3 draw during the [[Two-legged tie|first leg]]. He was described by Inter Milan manager [[Simone Inzaghi]] as "a phenomenon born every 50 years".<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-04-30 |title=Inzaghi: Phenoms like Yamal 'born every 50 years' |url=https://africa.espn.com/football/story/_/id/44939974/inter-inzaghi-barcelona-yamal-born-every-50-years |access-date=2025-05-01 |website=ESPN.com |language=en |archive-date=1 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250501000322/https://africa.espn.com/football/story/_/id/44939974/inter-inzaghi-barcelona-yamal-born-every-50-years |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2025, Yamal became the first player to win the [[Kopa Trophy]] twice, and he finished second in voting for the [[Ballon d'Or|Ballon d’Or]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-09-22 |title=Ballon d'Or 2025: Winners, reactions, and best moments from the gala |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/2025/09/22/68d167ff7aeb1c2f75b9e9e8-live.html |access-date=2026-07-20 |website=Marca|language=en-US |archive-date=22 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250922201951/https://www.marca.com/en/football/2025/09/22/68d167ff7aeb1c2f75b9e9e8-live.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== 2025–26: Long-term contract and first hat-trick ===
[[File:LamineYamal_-_FCB_-_Partido_Athletic_Club_vs_FC_Barcelona.jpg|thumb|Yamal celebrating a goal for [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] against [[Athletic Bilbao]] in 2026]]
On 27 May 2025, Yamal agreed to his first long-term contract with Barcelona, tying him to the club until June 2031 and to be signed upon his eighteenth birthday.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-27 |title=Lamine Yamal extends contract with FC Barcelona to 2031 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4274403/lamine-yamal-extends-contract-with-fc-barcelona-to-2031 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Sung |first=Patrick |date=2025-05-28 |title=17-year-old superstar Lamine Yamal signs contract extension with Barcelona until 2031 |url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/28/sport/lamine-yamal-contract-extension-barcelona-2031-spt |access-date=2025-05-28 |website= |publisher=[[CNN]] |language=en-US |archive-date=7 January 2026 that his contract could potentially reach a value of $45.3 million per year gross—including wages, bonuses and contract fees—making him one of Barcelona's top-paid players.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ballús |first=Pol |date=2025-05-28 |title=Lamine Yamal's new Barcelona contract: Inside the deal that could be worth nearly €40m a year |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6384986/2025/05/28/lamine-yamal-new-barcelona-contract-40m/ |access-date=2025-06-06 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331 |archive-date=8 contract signing event on 16 July, Yamal was presented with Barcelona's [[Squad number (association football)|number 10]] shirt.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-07-16 |title=Lamine Yamal is the FC Barcelona No.10 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4314453/lamine-yamal-is-the-fc-barcelona-no10 |access-date=2025-07-16 |work=FC Barcelona |language=en-US |archive-date=2 28 February 2026, he scored his first career [[hat-trick]] in a 4–1 win over [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-28 |title=Barcelona vs Villarreal summary: score, stats, goals & highlights {{!}} LaLiga 2025/26 |url=https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-vs-villarreal-live-online-score-stats-goals-updates-laliga-202526-f202602-n/ |access-date=2026-07-20 |website=AS USA late April, he suffered a torn hamstring, which sidelined him for the rest of the [[2025–26 FC Barcelona season|2025–26 season]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Marsden |first=Sam |date=23 April 2026 |title=Barcelona's Lamine Yamal out for season, expected to make World Cup |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48569662/barcelona-lamine-yamal-season-expected-fit-world-cup |work=ESPN season as the club's top scorer, with 24 goals and 17 assists in all competitions, including 16 goals and 11 assists in La Liga.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/lamine-yamals-2025-26-record-193800490.html |title=Lamine Yamal's 2025-26 record for FC Barcelona |publisher=Yahoo! == International career ==

=== Catalonia ===
Yamal played for youth teams of the [[Catalonia national football team]] from a young age. He was the captain of the under-12, under-14 and under-16 teams.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 September 2023 |title=Lamine Yamal, de les Seleccions Catalanes base a trencar rècords amb La Roja team in November 2022, he scored in a match against [[Castile and León autonomous football team|Castile and León]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ruano |first=Raúl |date=2024-07-10 |title=El golazo de Lamine ==== Euro 2024 champion ====
On 7 June 2024, Yamal was selected for the 26-man squad for the [[UEFA Euro 2024]] tournament.<ref>{{cite news |date=7 June 2024 |title=Official {{!}} Final Spain squad for the Euro 2024 finals |url=https://rfef.es/en/noticias/final-spain-squad-for-the-euro-2024-finals |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation]] |access-date=7 June 2024 |archive-date=21 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240621100501/https://rfef.es/en/noticias/final-spain-squad-for-the-euro-2024-finals |url-status=live }}</ref> On 15 June, he became the youngest player to appear in the competition, at age 16 years and 338 days.<ref>{{cite news |last=Pellizzeri |first=Teo |url=https://sport.optus.com.au/news/uefa-euro-2024/os75853/lamine-yamal-breaks-record-youngest-euro-player |title=Prodigy Lamine Yamal breaks record as youngest ever UEFA Euro player |work=Optus Sport |date=15 June 2024 |archive-date=8 July 2024 |access-date=15 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240708171327/https://sport.optus.com.au/news/uefa-euro-2024/os75853/lamine-yamal-breaks-record-youngest-euro-player |url-status=live }}</ref> During a match against [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]], he set up [[Dani Carvajal]]'s goal in a 3–0 victory, becoming the youngest player to provide an assist in the tournament's history.<ref>{{cite web |last=Mills |first=Richard |url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/spain-player-ratings-croatia-lamine-yamal-alvaro-morata/blt4cadab491a033fd2#cs283e6bb2a786e738 |title=Spain player ratings vs Croatia: Lamine Yamal is unbelievable! Record-breaking teenager stars as La Roja make easy work of Luka Modric & Co in strong start to Euro 2024 |website=Goal |date=15 June 2024 |access-date=15 June 2024 |archive-date=25 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240725002136/https://www.goal.com/en/lists/spain-player-ratings-croatia-lamine-yamal-alvaro-morata/blt4cadab491a033fd2#cs283e6bb2a786e738 |url-status=live }}</ref> In the round of 16 match against Georgia, he provided another assist in a 4–1 victory.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/news/028e-1b422f0a13e9-95e80bebdabb-1000--spain-4-1-georgia-resilient-la-roja-fight-back-to-reach-la/ |title=Spain 4-1 Georgia: Resilient La Roja fight back to reach quarter-finals |publisher=UEFA |date=30 June 2024 |access-date=30 June 2024 |archive-date=30 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240630212420/https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/news/028e-1b422f0a13e9-95e80bebdabb-1000--spain-4-1-georgia-resilient-la-roja-fight-back-to-reach-la/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Yamal provided an assist against [[Germany national football team|Germany]] in a 2–1 quarter-final win, tying the Spain national team record of three assists in a single Euro tournament.<ref>{{Cite news|first=Aditya|last=Gokhale|title=Starboy! Lamine Yamal matches incredible Spain record at 16 after providing brilliant assist in Euro 2024 quarter-final clash with Germany|url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/soccer/starboy-lamine-yamal-matches-incredible-spain-record-at-16-after-providing-brilliant-assist-in-euro-2024-quarter-final-clash-with-germany/ar-BB1pu9W6|website=[[MSNBC]]|date=5 July 2024|archive-date=31 May 2025|access-date=6 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250531031622/https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/soccer/starboy-lamine-yamal-matches-incredible-spain-record-at-16-after-providing-brilliant-assist-in-euro-2024-quarter-final-clash-with-germany/ar-BB1pu9W6|url-status=live}}</ref> In Spain's 2–1 semi-final victory over [[France national football team|France]], he scored with a curling shot from outside the [[penalty area]], becoming the [[UEFA European Championship records and statistics|youngest goalscorer]] in Euro tournament history four days before his 17th birthday. His goal was named the goal of the tournament.{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref name="BBCborn24">{{Cite news|first=Gary|last=Rose|title="A superstar is born" {{!}} Yamal's history making moment of "genius"|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cx82xyynw17o|website=[[BBC Sport]]|publisher=[[BBC]]|date=10 July 2024|archive-date=10 July 2024|access-date=24 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240710154821/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cx82xyynw17o|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|first=Jesse|last=Yomtov|title=Spain's Lamine Yamal nets sizzling goal, becomes youngest goal scorer in UEFA Euro history|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/2024/07/09/lamine-yamal-goal-spain-euro-2024/74342111007/|website=USA 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240715071348/https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/2024/07/09/lamine-yamal-goal-spain-euro-2024/74342111007/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Spain's Lamine Yamal, 16, 'genius' in Euro record evening|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/40527430/spain-lamine-yamal-16-youngest-euro-scorer|website=[[ESPN]]|date=9 July ==== 2026 World Cup champion ====
[[File:Lamine Yamal France v Spain 7.24.26-187.jpg|thumb|Yamal with [[Spain national football team|Spain]] playing against [[France national football team|France]] during the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#France vs Spain|2026 World Cup semifinals]]]]
On 25 May 2026, Yamal was named to the 26-man squad for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-squad-announcement-luis-de-la-fuente|title=Yamal, Rodri and Cucurella in strong Spain squad|date=25 May 2026|access-date=12 June 2026|language=en|archive-date=3 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260703093136/https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-squad-announcement-luis-de-la-fuente|url-status=live}}</ref> He arrived in the United States as he was recovering from a [[Biceps femoris muscle|biceps femoris]] injury that he suffered during the Barcelona season. Spain manager [[Luis de la Fuente (footballer, born 1961)|Luis de la Fuente]] decided that Yamal was not ready to start in the opening match against [[Cape Verde national football team|Cape Verde]], instead sending him on as a substitute in the second half of the eventual 0–0 draw.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/es/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/lamine-yamal-no-juega-contra-cabo-verde-cuando-debutar-copa-mundial-fifa-2026|title=¿Por qué Lamine Yamal no jugó de titular contra Cabo Verde?|date=14 June 2026|language=es|website=[[fifa.com]]}}</ref> On 21 June, Yamal scored his first World Cup goal as Spain defeated [[Saudi Arabia national football team|Saudi Arabia]] 4–0 in the group stage, becoming the second player aged 18 or younger to score the opening goal in a World Cup match since [[Pelé]] in 1958.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.msn.com/en-in/news/insight/lamine-yamal-equals-pel%C3%A9-s-68-year-old-world-cup-record/gm-GM129637C1 |title=Lamine Yamal equals Pelé's 68-year-old World Cup record |publisher=MSN |date=21 June 2026 |access-date=21 June 2026}}</ref><ref>{{citeweb|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49135958/spain-saudi-arabia-2026-world-cup-lamine-yamal-mikel-oyarzabal|title=Yamal nets 'dream' 1st World Cup goal as Spain answer critics|last=Dawson|first=Rob|publisher=[[ESPN]]|date=21 June 2026|accessdate=22 June 2026|archive-date=13 July 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260713094316/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49135958/spain-saudi-arabia-2026-world-cup-lamine-yamal-mikel-oyarzabal|url-status=live}}</ref> He was named Man of the Match in Spain's 3–0 round of 32 win against [[Austria national football team|Austria]] and its 2–1 quarter-final win against [[Belgium national football team|Belgium]].{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-austria-match-report-highlights |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260705195010/https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-austria-match-report-highlights |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49252849/fifa-world-cup-2026-stats-cristiano-ronaldo-first-ever-all-record-25-lamine-yamal-perfect-100 |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/spain-belgium-match-report-highlights |title=Merino books Spain semi-final ==Player profile==
A left-footed forward known for his dribbling, passing and chance-creating abilities, Yamal is able to play either as a [[centre-forward]], an [[attacking midfielder]] or a [[Winger (association football)|winger]], notably on the right flank.{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref name=Corbella /><ref>{{Cite web|title=Lamine Yamal position and style of play|url=https://www.coachesvoice.com/cv/barcelona-extraordinary-talent-lamine-yamal-style-of-play/|website=The Coaches' Voice|access-date=9 May 2024|archive-date=25 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240725002747/https://www.coachesvoice.com/cv/barcelona-extraordinary-talent-lamine-yamal-style-of-play/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.dw.com/en/spains-lamine-yamal-becomes-youngest-euros-player/a-69374470 |title=Spain's Lamine Yamal becomes youngest ever Euros player – DW – 06/15/2024 |website=dw.com |last1=Pearson |first1=Matt |date=15 June 2024 |access-date=22 June 2024 |archive-date=24 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240724080633/https://www.dw.com/en/spains-lamine-yamal-becomes-youngest-euros-player/a-69374470 |url-status=live }}</ref>}} His accurate crosses with the outside of his foot (known as ''[[trivela|trivelas]]'') have become one of the trademarks of his game.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/trivela-lamine-asombra-mundo-marca-112311163 |title=La 'trivela' de Lamine asombra al mundo y ya es marca registrada |website=sport.es |last1=Peyret |first1=Dídac |date=4 December 2024 |access-date=6 April 2025 |language=es |archive-date=7 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241207091451/https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/trivela-lamine-asombra-mundo-marca-112311163 |url-status=live }}</ref>

With his technical profile, Yamal has been compared to [[Lionel Messi]].<ref name="Corbella2">{{Cite web |last=Corbella|first=Enrique|title=Lamine Yamal, el niño de 15 años que ya entrena con el Barcelona: descubre al "mini Messi" de La Masía|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/barcelona/2022/09/05/6315a6aa268e3ead0d8b4588.html|date=5 September 2022|access-date=6 September 2022|website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|language=es|archive-date=6 September 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220906214946/https://www.marca.com/futbol/barcelona/2022/09/05/6315a6aa268e3ead0d8b4588.html}}</ref> He has also drawn comparisons with [[Neymar]] due to their similar playing style that involves a lot of dribbling, flair and chance creation.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/how-lamine-yamal-compares-to-lionel-messi-neymar-100-barcelona-games|title=How Lamine Yamal Compares to Lionel Messi, Neymar After 100 Barcelona Games?|access-date=11 October 2025|archive-date=23 July 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250723224711/https://www.si.com/soccer/how-lamine-yamal-compares-to-lionel-messi-neymar-100-barcelona-games|url-status=live}}</ref> Yamal has stated that Neymar is a major influence on the way he plays.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/who-is-lamine-yamal-everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-barcelona-wonderkid-barca-uncover-the-next-lionel-messi|title=Who is Lamine Yamal? Everything you need to know about the Barcelona wonderkid|publisher=fourfourtwo.com|last1=Dabbs|first1=Ryan|date=21 September 2023|access-date=21 June 2024|archive-date=15 July ==Personal life==
Yamal is a [[Muslims|Muslim]] and observes [[Ramadan]], which requires him to [[Fasting during Ramadan|fast from dawn until sunset]] for roughly a month, including on training and match days.<ref>{{Cite web |author=Emmanuel Mendez |date=2026-04-01 |title=Lamine Yamal's Ethnicity, Religion & Nationality |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/lamine-yamals-ethnicity-religion-nationality-144419672.html |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=Yahoo Sports |language=en-US |archive-date=15 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260715095720/https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/lamine-yamals-ethnicity-religion-nationality-144419672.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-19 |title=The Diet Lamine Yamal Will Follow During Ramadan |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/the-diet-lamine-yamal-will-follow-during-ramadan-2026-02-19 |access-date=2026-07-13 |website=beIN SPORTS |language=en-us |archive-date=14 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260714185459/https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/the-diet-lamine-yamal-will-follow-during-ramadan-2026-02-19 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Yamal was briefly in a relationship with [[Nicki Nicole]], an Argentinian singer, though the two separated in October 2025.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://people.com/who-is-nicki-nicole-lamine-yamal-11797013 |title=Who Is Lamine Yamal's Girlfriend? All About Grammy-Nominated Singer Nicki Nicole |website=People |date=2025 |access-date=20 September 2025 |archive-date=15 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250915205343/https://people.com/who-is-nicki-nicole-lamine-yamal-11797013 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=1 November 2025 |title=Barcelona's Lamine Yamal announces Nicki Nicole breakup – Get Spanish Football News |url=https://getfootballnewsspain.com/barcelonas-lamine-yamal-announces-nicki-nicole-breakup/ |access-date=1 November 2025 |website=getfootballnewsspain.com |language=en-US |archive-date=12 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251212065802/https://getfootballnewsspain.com/barcelonas-lamine-yamal-announces-nicki-nicole-breakup/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Following the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]], it was reported that he was in a relationship with Inés García.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-07-21 |title=How Lamine Yamal and his girlfriend Inés García celebrated Spain’s World Cup victory |url=https://www.hola.com/us/celebrities/20260721907999/how-lamine-yamal-his-girlfriend-ines-garcia-celebrated-spains-world-cup-victory/ |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=HOLA! USA |language=en-us |archive-date=22 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260722040005/https://www.hola.com/us/celebrities/20260721907999/how-lamine-yamal-his-girlfriend-ines-garcia-celebrated-spains-world-cup-victory/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

After Spain's [[Exhibition game|friendly match]] with Egypt in Barcelona on 31 March 2026, Yamal condemned [[anti-Muslim]] and [[xenophobic]] chants against Egyptian players by Spanish fans.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Keeley |first=Graham |title=Yamal slams anti-Muslim fan chants as Spain’s World Cup final hopes tainted |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/4/2/yamal-slams-anti-muslim-fan-chants-as-spains-world-cup-final-hopes-tainted |access-date=2026-06-09 |website=Al Jazeera |language=en |archive-date=12 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260712101459/https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/4/2/yamal-slams-anti-muslim-fan-chants-as-spains-world-cup-final-hopes-tainted |url-status=live }}</ref> He said the chants "were aimed at the opposing team and were not something personal against me, but as a Muslim, it is still a lack of respect and something intolerable."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Police investigate Islamophobic chants during Spain’s match with Egypt |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/4/1/spains-fa-condemns-islamophobic-chants-during-game-with-egypt |access-date=2026-06-09 |website=Al Jazeera |language=en}}</ref>

During a parade celebrating Barcelona's La Liga title victory on 11 May 2026, Yamal showed solidarity with [[Palestinians]] by waving a [[Palestinian flag]]. His action was praised by fans, pro-Palestinian activists, and the Spanish prime minister [[Pedro Sánchez]], while drawing criticism from Israel's defence minister [[Israel Katz]].{{efn-ua|Attributed to multiple references:<ref>{{cite news |title=Lamine Yamal’s Palestine flag wave hailed by fans, activists and athletes |website=[[Al Jazeera]] |date=12 May 2026 |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/5/12/lamine-yamals-palestine-flag-wave-hailed-by-fans-activists-and-athletes |access-date=13 May 2026 |archive-date=18 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260718062230/https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/5/12/lamine-yamals-palestine-flag-wave-hailed-by-fans-activists-and-athletes |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Israel Minister Criticises Lamine Yamal Over Palestinian Flag at Barcelona Title Parade |url=https://dailypioneer.com/news/slug-lite/israeli-minister-criticizes-yamal-for-waving-palestinian-flag?year=2026 |access-date=2026-05-17 |website=[[dailypioneer.com]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-05-15 |title=FC Barcelona says 'no comment' on Israel's accusation against Yamal |url=https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/05/15/fc-barcelona-tells-euronews-no-comment-after-israel-accuses-yamal-of-fuelling-hatred |access-date=2026-05-17 |website=[[Euronews]] |language=en |archive-date=17 May 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260517124056/https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/05/15/fc-barcelona-tells-euronews-no-comment-after-israel-accuses-yamal-of-fuelling-hatred |url-status=live }}</ref>}}

In June 2026, Yamal was named a [[UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador]], focusing on children's right to play and supporting children living in humanitarian emergencies, such as conflicts or natural disasters.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UNICEF names Lamine Yamal as a Goodwill Ambassador |url=https://www.unicef.org/press-releases/unicef-names-lamine-yamal-goodwill-ambassador |website=UNICEF |date=2026-06-11 |access-date=2026-06-12 |language=en |archive-date=11 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260611172311/https://www.unicef.org/press-releases/unicef-names-lamine-yamal-goodwill-ambassador |url-status=live }}</ref>
